name: 30 Hudson Yards (Edge)
frame: x east, y up, z south; metres
source: Floor by floor from data/buildings/hudson-yards.json (leasing deck, Architectural Record); OSM parts as a check
task: Timed-ticket visitor: 7 train to 34 St & Hudson Blvd, south toward Vessel into The Shops, up to the Edge entrance on Level 4, ticket scan, security, installations, 52-second elevator to the Level 100 sky deck.
open_questions: Edge publishes the steps but no floor plan: positions on Level 4 and Level 100 are assumed.
The order of ticket scan and security is assumed; the way out is not published (a separate exit back into The Shops is assumed).

The exterior, floors and sky deck come from the floor-by-floor model (leasing deck, Architectural Record, KPF). Level heights of The Shops are assumed; Level 4, at about 16 m, follows the lowest stop of the shaft taken to be Edge's.
Separately ticketed experiences (e.g. City Climb) and Peak restaurant use other entrances; not modelled.
